name: Hoshi Furu Yoru no Farnese
original_name: 星降る夜のファルネーゼ
source:
There once was a ‘good witch’ who used magic to bring prosperity to the world. The people were grateful to her and enjoyed her benevolence. However, a ‘bad witch’ appeared and incited the humans to kill her virtuous counterpart. With the powerful and wise ‘good witch’ no longer around, the ‘bad witch’ was free to do as she pleased.

The people suffered as she brought on fires and floods, destroying and corrupting everything she touched. They managed to kill her too and vowed to forget about magic, but she had cast a curse upon the world: witches will continue to exist in the world. Thus began a hunt for the ‘witches’ with the intent on exterminating them all. This is the beginning of the ‘star hunt’, which has continued for hundreds of years.

Etoile stood in the middle of a church in the capital, nervously awaiting the opening of a ‘star hunt’ trial. He was a new ‘astrologer’, an equivalent to a lawyer, tasked with defending a client for the first time. He was barely able to prove her innocence, although he hadn’t been able to find the true culprit.

Afterwards, a witch with a dog familiar suddenly appeared in front of him. She called herself the ‘Witch of Justice’ and offered to assist him. It is up to them to take back the ‘starry sky’!

The premise of the game is to regain the ‘starry sky’ which was lost because of the bad witch. You have to collect evidence to prove the innocence of your clients during the witch hunt. Along the way, you’ll find who the culprits (bad witches) are and defeat them to gradually regain the ‘constellations’. As you complete more cases, you’ll begin to see a link between the cases .

The evidence can found by searching places of interest, while the actual ‘star hunt’ involves stripping them by countering their lies and revealing the witch’s seal (constellation) on their bodies. To draw out the seal from their bodies, you must bring them to ‘ecstasy’.

[Edited from [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/12/05/december-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
曾经有一位“善良女巫”，用魔法为世界带来繁荣。人们感激她，享受她的仁慈。然而，一名“邪恶女巫”出现，煽动人类杀死她善良的同伴。失去强大而睿智的善良女巫后，邪恶女巫可以为所欲为。

她引发火灾与洪水，摧毁并腐化触碰的一切，让人们饱受苦难。人们最终也杀死了她，发誓遗忘魔法，但她已对世界施下诅咒：女巫将继续存在于世。于是，人类开始猎杀“女巫”，试图将她们全部消灭。这就是持续数百年的“星辰狩猎”起源。

首都教堂中央，艾托伊尔紧张等待“星辰狩猎”审判开始。他是一名新任“星术师”，相当于律师，第一次负责为委托人辩护。他勉强证明了她的清白，却没能找出真正凶手。

事后，一名带着狗使魔的女巫突然出现在他面前。她自称“正义女巫”，主动提出协助。夺回“星空”的任务，就交给他们了！

游戏目标是夺回因邪恶女巫而失去的“星空”。你必须在女巫狩猎中收集证据，为委托人证明清白。一路上，你会发现凶手（邪恶女巫）的身份，击败她们，逐步夺回“星座”。随着案件增加，你将看到案件之间的联系。

证据可以通过调查关键地点寻找，而真正的“星辰狩猎”则是反驳她们的谎言、揭露身体上的女巫印记（星座），将她们剥光。想从身体中引出印记，必须让她们达到高潮。
